paras.en: The large exothermic value of the lattice energy shows that the ion[scan obscured] lattice is very stable with respect to its gaseous ions. Higher the lattice energ[scan obscured] the stronger the ionic bonding in the lattice.

paras.en: It is impossible to determine the lattice energy of a compound by a singl[scan obscured] direct experiment. We can, however, calculate a value for ΔH_LE using sever[scan obscured] experimental values and an energy cycle called a Born–Haber cycle.
